body:
Hello. I'm writing this short report to inform people about a good way to cure a caffeine comedown.
The day before I was staying up all night, drinking 4 energy drinks, each containing 200mg's of caffeine (800mg total)
That really wasn't a good idea - the next day I felt terrible - my whole body hurt and I had a brain fog and very shaky hands. I also didn't sleep much.
I decided to take some electrolyte tablets. These tablets were sugar free and were supposed to be dissolved in water. I just took 3 of them, and split each one into 4 parts. Then I just ate each part like a candy (they tasted very good actually). Then I drank 1 liter of cold water. About 15 minutes of taking electrolytes and water my hands stopped shaking, my brain fog disappeared and I felt much much better.
Then I took 200 micrograms/ug of Huperzine A - and also, about 15 minutes I felt better - I felt more "sane" and all effects of my sleep deprivation have disappeared. I think I felt even better than yesterday.
